name: Pagination
code:
<p-pagination total-items-count="500" items-per-page="25" active-page="1"></p-pagination>
<p-pagination total-items-count="Some content" items-per-page="Some content" active-page="Some content"></p-pagination>

pageChange.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `update` event instead. Emitted when the page changes.

activePage.description: Index of the currently active page.

allyLabel.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `intl.root` instead. Aria label what the pagination is used for.

allyLabelNext.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `intl.next` instead. Aria label for next page icon.

allyLabelPage.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `intl.page` instead. Aria label for page navigation.

allyLabelPrev.description: @deprecated since v3.0.0, will be removed with next major release, use `intl.prev` instead. Aria label for previous page icon.

intl.description: Override the default wordings that are used for aria-labels on the next/prev and page buttons.

itemsPerPage.description: The total count of items which should be shown per page.

maxNumberOfPageLinks.description: Has no effect anymore @deprecated since v3.10.0, will be removed with next major release

showLastPage.description: Show or hide the button to jump to the last page.

theme.description: Adapts the color when used on dark background.
